item.title: Joined UFMS as Assistant Professor
item.dc:creator: Diogo B. Provete
item.description:
In September 2017 I joined the Institute of Biosciences of the Federal University of Mato Grosso do Sul (UFMS) in Campo Grande, Brazil, as an Assistant Professor.

This is the first entry in the dynamic CV — see posts/ in the repository for the file structure. New entries with categories: [experience] are automatically listed on the CV page.
